evidence: Adds an optional script evaluation tracer API and wrapper in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h for downstream consumers.
rationale: Exposes an optional script evaluation tracer through the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper for external analyzers and debuggers. Author and reviewers note clear utility for external tooling such as rust-bitcoinkernel debuggers and test observation, but as an optional diagnostic feature behind ENABLE_SCRIPT_TRACE, review is reasonably deferrable.
